_comment: Mountain Hardwear US-only apparel and snow packs, 2026-09-12 — the products the maker's Japanese store does not carry, read page by page on mountainhardwear.com after its PerimeterX check had been cleared by hand. Each garment stores the page's one 'Approx. Weight*' figure, which names no size, so size is recorded as unpublished; the snow packs are one row per torso size. Pages that print no weight (the Summit Grid fleeces, Oakoram, Butter Up, the logo tees and most hats and gloves) are not added.
